title: Implement batch list page (/batches)
description: Implement the batch list page showing all batches with their stats. Gateway to creating new batches or viewing existing ones.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows all batches in a table: name, industry, created date, total prospects, ready count
Empty state shown when no batches exist
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Server component. Load all batches via `listBatches()`. For each batch, count prospects by status using repository. Render table with shadcn/ui Table component.
Columns: Name (link to /batches/[id]), Industry (badge), Created (formatted date), Prospects (total), Ready (count with green badge). Add 'View' action button per row.
When no batches: show centered illustration/icon, message 'No batches yet. Create your first batch to get started.', 'New Batch' button.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify table renders correctly with batch data.
